graph.title: LEGO City 7893-1 Passenger Plane
notes: Minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, hats, hair) are not in the official parts list, so they are omitted. The black briefcase (b211) and the two flashlight hilts with neon cones (b212-b215) are minifig accessories. Their cones are joined to the hilts.

Connectivity fix: the booklet builds the plane and, separately, the luggage/stairs cart (page 6-7). In the cover and final pictures the cart stands at the plane's door with a minifigure on it. I therefore added contact edges: stairs b78 against the front door (door1.d), and the minifig-held items (black bag, 2 flashlight hilts) resting on the stairs/cart. These are contacts, not fastened joins. The cart itself is still a separate, unfastened model.

Booklet pictures are small and ports were not resolvable, so most joins use null ports. Stud-stacking joins are shown part-to-part, and each piece is joined to one or two supporting parts. Real contact is often wider.
Piece counts match the 387-piece inventory exactly: 215 top-level nodes plus 172 in repeats. Sub-assemblies built more than once (wheels, main gear, windows, doors, winglets, engines) are in repeats.
The 4 lego-2654 round plates are not visibly placed in the booklet. They are put one per jet engine as a loose contact.
The 18 window assemblies each join to dark-gray plate b140 as a stand-in, because the booklet does not show which plate each one sits on. The two lego-2377 windows join to b141 the same way.
Top-level edges refer to repeat copies by group+copy number (winglet1.wedge, winglet2.wedge, door1.d).
The two pre-printed domes in step 24 and the lego-4211740 piece are not in the parts list, so they are omitted.

The galley parts, cockpit parts, step-4/5 yellow/blue plates and the blue/dark-gray rail layers were assigned to plausible supporting parts. Counts and colours are correct, but exact positions are approximate.

Both main gear units are built with 2 wheel holders (4 wheels each). This is how the 5 wheel holders and 14 wheels in the inventory come out: 2 gears x 2 holders, plus 1 nose holder, plus 4 cart wheels.
The stickers (55075) are shown as a damaging-contact to the nose cabin only.
